# Vježba 7 — Zakrivljene plohe 2 {.unnumbered}

## Fizikalni uvod: simetrija i uzgon {.unnumbered}

Lokalna hidrostatska sila je $d\vec F=-p\vec n\,dA$, pri čemu je $p=\rho gz$. Na simetričnom potpuno uronjenom tijelu horizontalni se doprinosi na istoj dubini poništavaju. U vertikalnom smjeru tlak je na donjim elementima veći nego na odgovarajućim gornjim elementima, pa integral daje uzgon

$$ F_U=\rho gV_{\text{ist}}. $$

Za cilindar vrijedi $V_{\text{ist}}=\pi R^2b$ i $\sum F_H=0$. Veća dubina povećava sve lokalne tlakove, ali ne i uzgon ako se ne promijeni istisnuti volumen.

::: {.mf1-bridge}
#### Veza s Vježbama 3 i 6

Vježba 3 koristi $F_U=\rho_f gV_{ist}$ kao pravilo, a ovdje izvodimo zašto ono slijedi iz integrala lokalnih tlakova. Nakon dekompozicije $F_H$ i $F_V$ u Vježbi 6, sada se vidi i njihov lokalni vektorski izvor na luku.
:::

### Matematički most: od tlaka do uzgona {.unnumbered}

Uzmimo $+x$ udesno i $+z$ prema dolje, s centrom cilindra na dubini $z_C$. Za kružnicu su $x=R\cos\theta$, $z=z_C+R\sin\theta$ i vanjska normala $\vec n=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)$. Tlak djeluje prema unutrašnjosti tijela, zato je

$$
d\vec F=-\rho g(z_C+R\sin\theta)(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)bR\,d\theta.
$$

Za puni cilindar, $0\le\theta\le2\pi$, horizontalni članovi daju $F_x=0$, a vertikalni integral daje

$$
F_z=-\rho g\pi R^2b.
$$

Zbog odabrane osi $F_z<0$ znači silu prema gore, pa je $F_U=|F_z|=\rho gV_{\text{ist}}$. Članovi sa $z_C$ se ponište pri integraciji: jednoliko povećanje tlaka s dubinom ne stvara novu rezultantnu silu na zatvorenom tijelu.

### Zadatak Z1 — Cilindar na granici fluida {.unnumbered}

Fluid djeluje samo na lijevu polovicu cilindrične zakrivljene plohe; u presjeku ta ploha odgovara lijevom polukružnom luku. $h$ je **udaljenost slobodne površine od gornje točke cilindra**, pa je $z_C=h+R$.

<div class="zadano-grid"><div class="zadano-row"><span class="label">Zadano</span><span class="zadano-text">$h$, $R$, $b$ i $\rho$</span></div><div class="zadano-row"><span class="label">Odrediti</span><span class="zadano-text">$F_H$, $F_V$, $F_R$ i kut rezultante</span></div></div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Za lijevu polukružnu plohu je $A_v=2Rb$. Pomoćni volumen $V^*=\frac{\pi R^2}{2}b$ daje magnitudu vertikalne komponente; nije istisnuti volumen zatvorenog tijela niti nova primjena Arhimedova zakona. Zato vrijedi

$$ F_H=\rho g(h+R)(2Rb),\qquad F_V=\rho gV^*,\qquad F_R=\sqrt{F_H^2+F_V^2}. $$

Smjer $F_V$ je prema gore. Centar pritiska vertikalne projekcije i pravac vertikalne komponente su

$$
z_{FH}=z_C+\frac{R^2}{3z_C},\qquad x_{FV}=-\frac{4R}{3\pi}.
$$

Drugim riječima, $F_H$ djeluje malo ispod C, a $F_V$ prolazi lijevo od C. Njihovi se pravci sijeku u P; kroz P i C prolazi $F_R$. Provjera je $\tan\alpha=F_V/F_H=\pi R/(4z_C)=\Delta z/\Delta x$.

```{=html}
<div id="v7-t1-container" class="v7 mf1-lab"><div class="v7b"><div class="v7h"><h4>Z1 · lijeva polukružna ploha</h4><p>Narušena simetrija stvara horizontalnu i vertikalnu komponentu; rezultanta F<sub>R</sub> prolazi kroz C.</p></div><div class="v7s"><canvas id="z1c" width="920" height="590" aria-label="Lijeva polukružna ploha s komponentama hidrostatske sile"></canvas></div><div class="v7t"><button id="z1p" aria-pressed="false">Vertikalna projekcija A<sub>v</sub></button><button id="z1v" aria-pressed="false">Pomoćni volumen V*</button></div><div class="v7x"><label>Dubina gornje točke h <span class="v7r" id="z1hr"></span><input id="z1h" type="range" min=".2" max="4" step=".1" value="2"></label><label>Polumjer R <span class="v7r" id="z1rr"></span><input id="z1r" type="range" min=".5" max="1.5" step=".1" value="1"></label><label>Duljina b <span class="v7r" id="z1br"></span><input id="z1b" type="range" min=".5" max="3" step=".1" value="1"></label><label>Gustoća ρ <span class="v7r" id="z1pr"></span><input id="z1rho" type="range" min="800" max="1200" step="50" value="1000"></label></div><div class="v7o"><div><span>A<sub>v</sub></span><strong id="z1av"></strong></div><div><span>V*</span><strong id="z1vol"></strong></div><div><span>F<sub>H</sub> (desno)</span><strong id="z1fh"></strong></div><div><span>F<sub>V</sub> (gore)</span><strong id="z1fv"></strong></div><div><span>F<sub>R</sub></span><strong id="z1fr"></strong></div><div><span>φ<sub>R</sub></span><strong id="z1a"></strong></div><div><span>z<sub>FH</sub></span><strong id="z1zfh"></strong></div><div><span>x<sub>FV</sub></span><strong id="z1xfv"></strong></div><div><span>Točka P</span><strong id="z1point"></strong></div></div><div class="v7e" id="z1e"></div><p class="v7n" id="z1note">Desna strana nema par sila koji bi poništio F<sub>H</sub>. Donji dio mokre polukružnice daje F<sub>V</sub> prema gore.</p></div></div>
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById('v7-t1-container');
  if (!root || root.dataset.ready) return;
  root.dataset.ready = 'true';

  const canvas = root.querySelector('#z1c');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const byId = id => root.querySelector(`#${id}`);
  const controls = ['h', 'r', 'b', 'rho'].reduce((all, key) => ({...all, [key]: byId(`z1${key}`)}), {});
  const buttons = {projection: byId('z1p'), volume: byId('z1v')};
  const format = (value, digits = 2) => value.toLocaleString('hr-HR', {minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits});

  function readState() {
    return {
      h: +controls.h.value,
      R: +controls.r.value,
      b: +controls.b.value,
      rho: +controls.rho.value,
      showProjection: buttons.projection.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true',
      showVolume: buttons.volume.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true'
    };
  }

  function calculateModel(state) {
    const g = 9.81;
    const zC = state.h + state.R;
    const Av = 2 * state.R * state.b;
    const Vstar = Math.PI * state.R ** 2 * state.b / 2;
    const FH = state.rho * g * zC * Av / 1000;
    const FV = state.rho * g * Vstar / 1000;
    return {
      ...state, zC, Av, Vstar, FH, FV,
      FR: Math.hypot(FH, FV),
      phiR: Math.atan2(FV, FH) * 180 / Math.PI,
      zFH: zC + state.R ** 2 / (3 * zC),
      xFV: -4 * state.R / (3 * Math.PI)
    };
  }

  function arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width = 3, label = '') {
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
    const head = 8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - head * Math.cos(angle - .5), y2 - head * Math.sin(angle - .5));
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - head * Math.cos(angle + .5), y2 - head * Math.sin(angle + .5));
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    if (label) {
      ctx.font = '700 14px system-ui';
      ctx.fillText(label, (x1 + x2) / 2 + 6, (y1 + y2) / 2 - 7);
    }
  }

  function renderScene(model) {
    const W = 700, H = 450, waterY = 48;
    const scale = Math.min(80, 280 / (model.h + 2 * model.R));
    const radius = model.R * scale;
    const cx = 390, cy = waterY + model.zC * scale;
    const px = cx + model.xFV * scale;
    const py = waterY + model.zFH * scale;

    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dff2f9'; ctx.fillRect(48, waterY, cx - 48, H - waterY);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#147b9a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(48, waterY); ctx.lineTo(cx, waterY); ctx.stroke();

    if (model.showVolume) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - radius);
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI * .5, true);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = '#6e63bb38'; ctx.fill();
    }
    if (model.showProjection) {
      ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]); ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b7898';
      ctx.strokeRect(cx - 7, cy - radius, 14, 2 * radius); ctx.restore();
      ctx.fillStyle = '#0b7898'; ctx.font = '650 13px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('Aᵥ = 2Rb', cx + 18, cy);
    }

    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#9aabb6'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#17324d'; ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.stroke();
    [120, 150, 210, 240].forEach(degrees => {
      const t = degrees * Math.PI / 180;
      const nx = Math.cos(t), ny = Math.sin(t);
      arrow(cx + (radius + 34) * nx, cy + (radius + 34) * ny, cx + radius * nx, cy + radius * ny, '#1986a8', 2);
    });
    ctx.fillStyle = '#17324d'; ctx.font = '700 14px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('C', cx + 8, cy - 8);
    ctx.save(); ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]); ctx.strokeStyle = '#7191a2'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - 160, py); ctx.lineTo(cx + 95, py); ctx.moveTo(px, py - 28); ctx.lineTo(px, py + 125); ctx.stroke(); ctx.restore();
    arrow(px - 135, py, px + 80, py, '#0b7898', 3, 'Fₕ');
    arrow(px, py + 108, px, py - 18, '#198754', 3, 'Fᵥ');
    arrow(px, py, cx, cy, '#c73c42', 4, 'Fᵣ');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c73c42'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, 4, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.fill();
    ctx.font = '700 14px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('P', px + 7, py - 8);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4b6577'; ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('zFH', cx + 38, py - 5); ctx.fillText('xFV', px - 28, py + 138);
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  }

  function renderOutputs(model) {
    byId('z1hr').textContent = `${format(model.h)} m`;
    byId('z1rr').textContent = `${format(model.R)} m`;
    byId('z1br').textContent = `${format(model.b)} m`;
    byId('z1pr').textContent = `${model.rho.toLocaleString('hr-HR')} kg/m³`;
    byId('z1av').textContent = `${format(model.Av)} m²`;
    byId('z1vol').textContent = `${format(model.Vstar)} m³`;
    byId('z1fh').textContent = `${format(model.FH, 1)} kN`;
    byId('z1fv').textContent = `${format(model.FV, 1)} kN ↑`;
    byId('z1fr').textContent = `${format(model.FR, 1)} kN`;
    byId('z1a').textContent = `${format(model.phiR, 1)}°`;
    byId('z1zfh').textContent = `${format(model.zFH)} m`;
    byId('z1xfv').textContent = `${format(Math.abs(model.xFV))} m lijevo od C`;
    byId('z1point').textContent = `(${format(model.xFV)} m, ${format(model.zFH)} m)`;
    byId('z1e').innerHTML = `z<sub>C</sub> = h + R = ${format(model.zC)} m; A<sub>v</sub> = 2Rb; V* = πR²b/2. F<sub>H</sub> = ρgz<sub>C</sub>A<sub>v</sub>; F<sub>V</sub> = ρgV*.`;
    byId('z1note').innerHTML = `F<sub>H</sub> djeluje desno kroz z<sub>FH</sub>, a F<sub>V</sub> gore kroz x<sub>FV</sub>. Promjene ρ i b množe obje sile, dok povećanje h povećava samo F<sub>H</sub>.`;
  }

  function update() {
    const model = calculateModel(readState());
    renderScene(model);
    renderOutputs(model);
  }

  Object.values(controls).forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', update));
  Object.values(buttons).forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', button.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true');
    update();
  }));
  update();
})();
</script>
```

## Opći kružni luk: numerička integracija {.unnumbered}

Za opći uronjeni luk koristimo $x=R\cos\theta$, $z=z_C+R\sin\theta$ i

$$ d\vec F=-\rho gz(\theta)bR(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\,d\theta. $$

Numerički zbroj čuva predznake sila, pa radi i kada luk prijeđe krajnje položaje kružnice ili $360^\circ$.

F<sub>R</sub> prolazi kroz C.</p></div><div class="v7p"><button data-p="q">Donja četvrtina</button><button data-p="l">Lijeva polukružnica</button><button data-p="d">Desna polukružnica</button><button data-p="f">Puni cilindar</button></div><div class="v7x"><label>Početni kut α<sub>1</sub> <span class="v7r" id="a1r"></span><input id="a1" type="range" min="0" max="330" step="5" value="0"></label><label>Raspon Δα <span class="v7r" id="asr"></span><input id="as" type="range" min="30" max="360" step="5" value="90"></label><label>Dubina centra z<sub>C</sub> <span class="v7r" id="azr"></span><input id="az" type="range" min="0.7" max="5" step=".1" value="3"></label><label>Polumjer R <span class="v7r" id="arr"></span><input id="ar" type="range" min=".5" max="1.5" step=".1" value="1"></label><label>Duljina b <span class="v7r" id="abr"></span><input id="ab" type="range" min=".5" max="3" step=".1" value="1"></label></div><div class="v7o"><div><span>F<sub>x</sub> (potpisano)</span><strong id="afx"></strong></div><div><span>F<sub>z</sub> (potpisano)</span><strong id="afz"></strong></div><div><span>F<sub>R</sub></span><strong id="afr"></strong></div><div><span>Broj elemenata N</span><strong id="an"></strong></div></div><div class="v7e" id="ae"></div><p class="v7n" id="anote"></p></div></div>
```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const root = document.getElementById('v7-widget-a-container');
  if (!root || root.dataset.ready) return;
  root.dataset.ready = 'true';

  const canvas = root.querySelector('#ac');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const byId = id => root.querySelector(`#${id}`);
  const controls = {a1: byId('a1'), span: byId('as'), zC: byId('az'), R: byId('ar'), b: byId('ab')};
  const presets = [...root.querySelectorAll('[data-p]')];
  const radians = Math.PI / 180;
  const rho = 1000, g = 9.81, epsilon = .2;
  const format = (value, digits = 2) => value.toLocaleString('hr-HR', {minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits});

  function readState() {
    const R = +controls.R.value;
    const minimumDepth = R + epsilon;
    controls.zC.min = minimumDepth.toFixed(1);
    if (+controls.zC.value < minimumDepth) controls.zC.value = minimumDepth.toFixed(1);
    return {a1: +controls.a1.value, span: +controls.span.value, zC: +controls.zC.value, R, b: +controls.b.value, minimumDepth};
  }

  function calculateForces(state) {
    const theta1 = state.a1 * radians;
    const theta2 = (state.a1 + state.span) * radians;
    const N = Math.max(360, Math.ceil(state.span * 4));
    const dTheta = (theta2 - theta1) / N;
    let fxNumerical = 0, fzNumerical = 0;
    for (let index = 0; index < N; index += 1) {
      const theta = theta1 + (index + .5) * dTheta;
      const pressure = rho * g * (state.zC + state.R * Math.sin(theta));
      const dA = state.b * state.R * dTheta;
      fxNumerical -= pressure * Math.cos(theta) * dA;
      fzNumerical -= pressure * Math.sin(theta) * dA;
    }
    fxNumerical /= 1000; fzNumerical /= 1000;

    const integralX = theta => state.zC * Math.sin(theta) + state.R * Math.sin(theta) ** 2 / 2;
    const integralZ = theta => -state.zC * Math.cos(theta) + state.R * (theta / 2 - Math.sin(2 * theta) / 4);
    const factor = -rho * g * state.b * state.R / 1000;
    const fxAnalytical = factor * (integralX(theta2) - integralX(theta1));
    const fzAnalytical = factor * (integralZ(theta2) - integralZ(theta1));
    const FR = Math.hypot(fxNumerical, fzNumerical);
    const error = 100 * Math.hypot(fxNumerical - fxAnalytical, fzNumerical - fzAnalytical) / Math.max(1, Math.hypot(fxAnalytical, fzAnalytical));
    return {...state, theta1, theta2, N, fxNumerical, fzNumerical, fxAnalytical, fzAnalytical, FR, error};
  }

  function arrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width = 3, label = '') {
    const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1), head = 8;
    ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - head * Math.cos(angle - .5), y2 - head * Math.sin(angle - .5));
    ctx.lineTo(x2 - head * Math.cos(angle + .5), y2 - head * Math.sin(angle + .5));
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    if (label) { ctx.font = '700 14px system-ui'; ctx.fillText(label, (x1 + x2) / 2 + 6, (y1 + y2) / 2 - 7); }
  }

  function drawScene(model) {
    const W = 720, H = 460, waterY = 48;
    const scale = Math.min(92, 275 / (model.zC + model.R));
    const cx = 350, cy = waterY + model.zC * scale, radius = model.R * scale;
    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width / W, 0, 0, canvas.height / H, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dff2f9'; ctx.fillRect(42, waterY, 636, H - waterY);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#147b9a'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(42, waterY); ctx.lineTo(678, waterY); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, 0, 2 * Math.PI); ctx.strokeStyle = '#9aabb6'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, radius, model.theta1, model.theta2); ctx.strokeStyle = '#17324d'; ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#17324d'; ctx.font = '700 14px system-ui'; ctx.fillText('C', cx + 8, cy - 8);
    for (let index = 0; index < 10; index += 1) {
      const theta = model.theta1 + (index + .5) * (model.theta2 - model.theta1) / 10;
      const nx = Math.cos(theta), ny = Math.sin(theta);
      arrow(cx + (radius + 30) * nx, cy + (radius + 30) * ny, cx + radius * nx, cy + radius * ny, '#1986a8', 2);
    }
    if (model.FR > .01) {
      const vectorScale = 90 / Math.max(Math.abs(model.fxNumerical), Math.abs(model.fzNumerical), 1);
      const vx = cx - model.fxNumerical * vectorScale, vy = cy - model.fzNumerical * vectorScale;
      arrow(vx, vy, cx, vy, '#0b7898', 3, 'Fₓ');
      arrow(cx, vy, cx, cy, '#198754', 3, 'F_z');
      arrow(vx, vy, cx, cy, '#c73c42', 4, 'Fᵣ');
    }
    ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  }

  function renderOutputs(model) {
    const signed = (value, positiveDirection, negativeDirection) => `${value >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}${format(Math.abs(value), 1)} kN ${value >= 0 ? positiveDirection : negativeDirection}`;
    byId('a1r').textContent = `${format(model.a1, 0)}°`;
    byId('asr').textContent = `${format(model.span, 0)}°`;
    byId('azr').textContent = `${format(model.zC)} m`;
    byId('arr').textContent = `${format(model.R)} m`;
    byId('abr').textContent = `${format(model.b)} m`;
    byId('afx').textContent = signed(model.fxNumerical, '→', '←');
    byId('afz').textContent = signed(model.fzNumerical, '↓', '↑');
    byId('afr').textContent = `${format(model.FR, 1)} kN`;
    byId('an').textContent = model.N.toLocaleString('hr-HR');
    byId('ae').innerHTML = `Numerički: F<sub>x</sub> = Σ[−ρgz(θ)bR cosθ Δθ], F<sub>z</sub> = Σ[−ρgz(θ)bR sinθ Δθ]. Analitički: F<sub>x</sub> = ${format(model.fxAnalytical)} kN, F<sub>z</sub> = ${format(model.fzAnalytical)} kN. Relativna pogreška numeričkog zbroja iznosi ${format(model.error, 3)} %.`;
    byId('anote').innerHTML = `Osi su +x udesno i +z prema dolje. Widget pretpostavlja da je cijela referentna kružnica uronjena: z<sub>C</sub> ≥ R + ε, gdje je ε = ${format(epsilon)} m. Zato su svi odabrani lukovi potpuno mokri. Za inženjerske magnitude vrijedi F<sub>H</sub> = |F<sub>x</sub>| i F<sub>V</sub> = |F<sub>z</sub>|, uz smjer iz predznaka.`;
  }

  function update() {
    const model = calculateForces(readState());
    drawScene(model);
    renderOutputs(model);
  }

  const presetValues = {q: [0, 90], l: [90, 180], d: [270, 180], f: [0, 360]};
  Object.values(controls).forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', update));
  presets.forEach(button => {
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const [a1, span] = presetValues[button.dataset.p];
      controls.a1.value = a1; controls.span.value = span;
      presets.forEach(candidate => candidate.setAttribute('aria-pressed', candidate === button ? 'true' : 'false'));
      update();
    });
  });
  update();
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
/* Dodatne provjere i oznake: svaki izračun ostaje vezan uz trenutačne kontrole. */
(()=>{
  const root=document.getElementById('widget-submerged-sym');
  const R=1,b=1,rho=1000,g=9.81,V=Math.PI*R*R*b,FU=rho*g*V/1000;
  root.querySelector('#symvol').textContent=V.toLocaleString('hr-HR',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2})+' m³';
  root.querySelector('#symfu').textContent=FU.toLocaleString('hr-HR',{minimumFractionDigits:1,maximumFractionDigits:1})+' kN';
  const caption=root.querySelector('#symcap'),note=root.querySelector('#symn');
  const explain=step=>{
    const copy={
      1:['Korak 1: p = ρgz — povećanje zC produžuje sve strelice tlaka, ali ne mijenja njihov smjer.','Svaka lokalna sila je okomita na plohu i usmjerena prema unutrašnjosti cilindra.'],
      2:['Korak 2: na istoj dubini tlakovi lijevo i desno su jednaki.','Parovi dFHL i dFHD imaju jednak iznos i suprotan vodoravni smjer, zato je ΣFH = 0.'],
      3:['Korak 3: donji tlak je veći od gornjega, pa neto vertikalni integral djeluje prema gore.','FU = ρgVist prolazi kroz C jer je C centar istisnutog volumena, odnosno centar uzgona homogenog cilindra.']
    }[step];
    caption.textContent=copy[0];note.innerHTML=copy[1];
  };
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-k]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>explain(+button.dataset.k)));
  explain(1);
})();

</script>
```

## Usporedba slučajeva {.unnumbered}

| Slučaj | $F_H$ | $F_V$ | Ovisnost o apsolutnoj dubini |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Puni cilindar | $0$ | uzgon | $F_U$ ne ovisi o dubini. |
| Lijeva polukružna ploha | različit od nule | različit od nule | $F_H$ raste s $h$; $F_V$ ne ovisi o $h$. |
| Opći kružni luk | iz integrala | iz integrala | Ovisi o položaju i geometriji odabranog luka. |

## Sažetak {.unnumbered}

1. Na potpuno uronjenom simetričnom cilindru horizontalni se doprinosi poništavaju, a ostaje uzgon.
2. Kada fluid opterećuje samo dio kružne plohe, nastaju $F_H$ i $F_V$; njihova rezultanta prolazi kroz C.
3. Numerička integracija lokalne sile $d\vec F$ generalizira postupak na proizvoljan uronjeni kružni luk.
